Name: Mandatory Bug Fix Patch
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[u][size=6][b]Mandatory Bug Fix Patch[/b]

[/size][/u][size=3]Changes certain tiles in the mines. Purely a visual change. Works with recolours and all map versions using similar layouts.

[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher

[/url][/size]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[/size][size=5][u][b]Extra[/b][/u]
[/size][size=3]I've been informed that there are more of these tile bugs in other levels of the mines (Check video section for reference). I will update the mod with more of these fixes in the near future. If you can find more of these errors, let me know and I will try to fix them! :)[/size]
